scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @florece/shared && npm run build -w @florece/api && npm run build -w @florece/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @florece/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @florece/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @florece/shared && npm run typecheck -w @florece/api --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @florece/web --if-present
